U.S. Political Map

Presidential results by state and county, plus a live election tracker

Connect a data feed

Paste the address of a JSON feed that allows requests from a web page (CORS). The tab loads it every 30 seconds. Races use two-letter state codes; Maine and Nebraska districts use keys like ME-2 for the president.

{
  "updated": "2026-11-03T22:15:00-05:00",
  "races": [
    { "office": "senate",    "state": "GA", "leader": "D",
      "dem": 50.1, "rep": 48.9, "reporting": 87, "called": false },
    { "office": "governor",  "state": "AZ", "leader": "R", "called": true },
    { "office": "president", "state": "PA", "leader": "R", "called": false }
  ],
  "winner": { "president": "R" },
  "house": { "dem": 201, "rep": 190, "other": 0 }
}

Offices: president, senate, governor. Leader: D, R or I. You can also set DEFAULT_FEED_URL near the top of the page’s script.

Build your ballot

Tell us where you vote. We show the races you will see on November 3, 2026, and update live results for each one every 30 seconds.

Exact ballot, down to local races (optional)

Paste a free Google API key with the Civic Information API enabled, plus your full street address above. Google then returns every contest and ballot measure for your address, once its data is published. Your address and key go from your browser straight to Google.
